system.description: You've built a new capability into one of your automatons—the robot can use its action to transform into an armored suit that you wear until you use a one-hour or longer recovery. If you are within an immediate distance when it transforms, it automatically forms itself around you. The transformed automaton acts as heavy armor; because it anticipates and reacts to your movements, you can freely use this armor. Enabler.
